Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of LLY.
Operating income reached $8.1 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
Revenue guidance of $37.5 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2022.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $0.59 per share.
While we remain optimistic, there can be no assurance that macroeconomic headwinds won't affect demand.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. Our gross margin expanded by 199 basis points to 58.9%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
Second question - Analyst:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 199 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
